segments.speaker: Narrator
segments.text: The dealer laughs, a dry little sound, and the fresco-side player snorts into his cards. Nobody reaches for the three coins.

segments.speaker: Dealer
segments.text: Three. He offers the dead three, as if they were a ferryman with a bad leg. No, keeper of rabbits. The price was ten when you arrived and it is ten still. The dead do not bargain, and neither do their servants.

segments.speaker: Kit
segments.text: The ask stays at ten. What do you do?
segments.reacts_to: The price was ten when you arrived and it is ten still.
